anchor.method: FY2026E income statement = 9M-2026 actuals + explicit Q4 estimates (solved iteratively for Q4 avg investments); FY2026E balance sheet = 30 Sep 2026 actuals + Q4 growth; FY2027E-FY2030E linked to macro.csv nominal GDP, CPI, policy rate, T-bills, and 10Y bond yield. FX currency split is unavailable in GSE summary statements, so FX revaluation is not modelled separately.

q4_2026_loan_growth_pct.note: Q4-2026 net loan growth over 30 Sep 2026.

q4_2026_deposit_growth_pct.note: Q4-2026 customer deposit growth over 30 Sep 2026.

q4_2026_flow_scale.note: Q4-2026 non-interest income and opex run-rate as fraction of 9M-2026.

loan_spread_over_nom_gdp_pct.note: FY2027E+ loan growth = nominal GDP (from macro.csv) + 1.0%.

deposit_spread_over_nom_gdp_pct.note: FY2027E+ deposit growth = nominal GDP (from macro.csv) + 0.0%.

opex_spread_over_cpi_pct.note: FY2027E+ staff/other opex growth = inflation_cpi_pct (from macro.csv) + 2.0%.

npl_step_pct.note: Annual NPL ratio change (pp) from 9M-2026 14.99%, floored at 5.0%.

cost_of_risk_pct.note: Annualised impairment charge / average net loans.

tax_rate_pct.note: Effective tax rate including statutory levies.

target_car_pct.note: Internal CAR proxy target buffer above 13.0% min_car_pct.
